risks.reasoning: The latest reported period, the six months ended 30 September 2019, had positive net cash from operating activities of RM21.817 million and cash and cash equivalents of RM39.079 million.   Under Protocol v1.1.1, non-negative operating cash flow means there is no operating cash burn, so cash runway is not triggered.

The audited historical financial information reports positive profit and total comprehensive income for each of the three comparable financial years ended 31 March 2017, 2018 and 2019; the six months ended 30 September 2019 was also profitable.  There are therefore no comparable loss periods meeting the frozen continuous-loss trigger.

Revenue increased in every disclosed comparable comparison: FY2017 to FY2018, FY2018 to FY2019, and six months ended 30 September 2018 to the corresponding 2019 period.  No comparable revenue decline below 0%, and therefore no -20% high-severity decline, is present.

The formal Business disclosure states that no customer accounted for 5% or more of total revenue in each Track Record Period.  This proves a strict largest-customer bound of <5%; consequently, even the sum of any five customers is strictly <25%, excluding both the frozen medium and high concentration thresholds.

Across the Track Record Period, the disclosed largest-supplier shares were 18.9%, 13.8%, 15.3% and 19.0%, while top-five supplier shares were 55.3%, 50.9%, 54.9% and 57.0%.  All are below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% for the largest supplier and 60% for the top five, and therefore also below the high thresholds.

The prospectus defines the Company's shares as ordinary shares and states that the offer shares rank pari passu with all shares already issued or to be allotted and issued.   The Articles' generic power to issue shares on redeemable terms is boilerplate and does not evidence any actual effective or restorable special redemption right. The full prospectus review identified no pre-IPO investor redemption arrangement.

As of the Latest Practicable Date, the Group had obtained all licences, permits and approvals material to its Malaysian operations, with no legal impediment to renewal advised by Malaysian legal counsel.  It also disclosed no material litigation, arbitration or claims and no non-compliance event that had or might have a material adverse effect.

The accountants' report records customer-contract revenue from sales of optical products to retail customers, franchisees and affiliates throughout the Track Record Period.  The core products were therefore commercialized and generating product-sales revenue.
